name: Rum Ham's Avatar World
creator: Rum Ham
description: Rum Ham's Avatar World is a meme-focused avatar showcase built by the creator Rum Ham, gathering a large collection of silly and intentionally over-the-top avatars, many accompanied by loud music or sound effects. Numerous avatars use clip-art-style cutouts and figures of internet personalities and celebrities, with Danny DeVito and Nicolas Cage recurring as particular running jokes throughout the world, including a small shrine-style area referencing DeVito. The world has been a favorite drop-in spot for comedic roleplay and random character events within the community.
